posts.text:
Nepal: Indian nationals do not need a visa. Carry a valid Indian passport or Election Commission voter card.

Nepal Tourism Board says Aadhaar is not an accepted travel document.
posts.alt: Nepal photo and tourist-entry documents for Indian nationals. No visa required. Carry a valid Indian passport or Election Commission voter card; Nepal Tourism Board does not accept Aadhaar as a travel document. Rules checked October 20, 2026.

posts.text:
Bhutan: Indian visitors need an entry permit, not a visa. Carry an Indian passport or voter ID.

A 5-night inland trip costs INR 6,000 in adult SDF (INR 1,200/night), plus accommodation and the mandatory guide.
posts.alt: Bhutan flag and tourist-entry rules for Indian visitors. Entry permit required; carry an Indian passport or voter ID and follow approved permit dates. Adult SDF: INR 1,200 per night. Example: 5 inland nights cost INR 6,000 in SDF, with accommodation and a mandatory guide extra. Checked October 20, 2026.

posts.text:
Maldives: tourist visa on arrival. Bring an MRZ passport valid at least 1 month, prepaid registered accommodation and return ticket.

Submit the free IMUGA traveller declaration within 96 hours before arrival.
posts.alt: Maldives flag and tourist-entry checklist for Indian ordinary passports. Visa and admissibility assessed on arrival. Bring an MRZ passport valid at least 1 month, prepaid registered accommodation and return ticket. Each traveller submits the free IMUGA declaration within 96 hours before arrival. Check the stay granted at entry; IMUGA is a declaration, not an eVisa. Checked October 20, 2026.

posts.text:
Indonesia: Indian passports qualify for B1 visa on arrival, IDR 500,000 for up to 30 days; one extension to 60 days total.

Passport valid at least 6 months and onward/return ticket required. Online e-VOA available.
posts.alt: Indonesia photo and B1 tourist-visa rules for Indian ordinary passports. IDR 500,000 for up to 30 days, with one extension to 60 days total. Passport valid at least 6 months and onward or return ticket required. Online e-VOA must be used within 90 days of issue; that is its use-by period, not the stay length. Checked October 20, 2026.
